Usage: gacli report run [options]

Run a standard GA4 report

Options:
  -m, --metrics <metrics...>        Metrics to include in the report
  -d, --dimensions <dimensions...>  Dimensions to include in the report
  --start-date <date>               Start date for the report (default:
                                    "7daysAgo")
  --end-date <date>                 End date for the report (default: "today")
  --limit <number>                  Maximum number of rows to return
  --offset <number>                 Row offset for pagination
  --order-by <orderBys...>          Order by specifications (e.g.
                                    "metric:sessions:desc")
  --dimension-filter <filters...>   Dimension filters
  --metric-filter <filters...>      Metric filters
  --keep-empty-rows                 Include rows with all zero metric values
  -h, --help                        display help for command
